title: Hyperbolic TIme Chamber
author: Prince  G.
desc:
Designed to help u get jacked. Upper body focused. Upper Lower Upper Rest Repeat it again

Take a rest day after Upper B then go back to Upper A.

Example 
Sunday : Upper A 
Monday : Lower 
Tuesday: Upper B
Wednesday: Rest 
Thursday: Upper A
Friday: Lower 
Saturday: Upper B
Sunday : Rest 

Next week the program will start on Monday as the program doesn’t revolve around fixed day so each week different days will have different workout
